caseNameFull: HASWELL v. POWELL, SECRETARY OF STATE OF ILLINOIS
attorneys: John C. Tucker for appellant., William G. Clark, Attorney General of Illinois, and John J. O’Toole and Robert F. Nix, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
